No high knee marching.

Preserve navy straight hair bun/turquoise-gold pin/blue tassel, ivory-blue-gold wave cloud robe, blue water-dragon fully open ivory fan. Do not transfer fan to the near left arm. Frame has normal running contact body level, not bouncing whole body up arbitrarily. Clear transparent margin minimum30px allaround, no auto-fit per-frame. Keep body centered at same fixed root, allowing actual limb swing and small torso bob.
One fullbody native cel, actual transparentbackground. No checkerboard/background, shadow, text,UI,sheet,multipleposes, effectparticles,glow,waterdragon projectile,motionblur. No mirror/warp/interpolation. Maintain bright soft-painted volume and fine warmgold outlines from approvedstyle.
